reason: A reusable development container for DeepSeek Harness browser plugins that manages UI surfaces and document providers and exposes them through an optional remote JSON-RPC protocol.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 浏览器插件提供可复用的 UI surface、文档提供器、React 宿主及可选远程通信协议。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness browser plugins with reusable UI surfaces, document providers, React hosts, and an optional remote communication protocol.

capabilities: Provides reusable UI surfaces and document providers for browser plugins
Projects document snapshots and change notifications across MessagePort or WebSocket channels
Routes opt-in open, reveal, and close commands to mounted UI sessions
